core_problem_solved: To provide the official, low-level Java driver for connecting to and interacting with a MongoDB database server, handling all aspects of the MongoDB wire protocol.
key_features: Implementation of the MongoDB wire protocol
APIs for CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations
Connection management to a MongoDB replica set or sharded cluster
era_and_niche: The standard Java driver for MongoDB for many years, used by all Java applications connecting to the database before the major rewrite in the 3.x driver series.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is the **legacy driver** and is now **obsolete**. It was completely replaced by the modern, unified MongoDB 3.x+ Java Driver. The direct modern successor for most applications is **`org.mongodb:mongodb-driver-sync`** (for synchronous operations), which is part of the new modular framework built around `mongodb-driver-core`.
